purpose: Freeze the authoritative daily-price endpoints, tick tolerances and parsing rules used to crosscheck the pinned third-party 5-minute source. No CSI1000 target data may be read.

DCE_I.official_reference_requirement: DCE iron-ore contract specification; validator must preserve the exact official response/reference when available. The 0.5 tick has applied to the frozen 2016/2018/2020 samples after the April 2015 contract amendment.

SHFE.fallback_semantics: same SHFE-owned daily-data path only; fallback is allowed only for HTTP/TLS/host compatibility, not after inspecting prices
SHFE.expected_payload: JSON object containing contract-level daily rows such as o_curinstrument
SHFE.match_rule: normalize PRODUCTID/product id and DELIVERYMONTH/delivery month to exact frozen contract; no main/continuous-series substitution

DCE.fallback_semantics: daily_html and daily_export are two official representations of the same DCE daily query. The parser may use whichever returns a machine-readable exact contract row; it may not switch to a third-party price source.
DCE.match_rule: exact frozen iron-ore contract code only; no main/continuous-series substitution

comparison.absolute_tolerance: one frozen minimum price tick per product per field
comparison.missing_or_non_numeric_authoritative_fie: sample unavailable for that field; do not infer from settlement or adjacent contract

transport_raw_verification.git_blob_identity: compute SHA1 of b'blob '+decimal_byte_length+b'\0'+raw_bytes and require equality to the frozen Git blob SHA
